paragraphs.body: LiveScore reports that Simone Inzaghi (referred to as Gasperini in source text) warned Roma fans about the goal-hungry nature of the team ahead of a European clash against a team featuring injured Red Devils players. Soccer News adds that Inzaghi felt Roma had effectively dropped two points in their recent draw against Napoli, while Yahoo Sports quotes Allegri expressing his frustration after the 3-3 draw, stating he might not be on the touchline. Football Italia notes that Inzaghi believes the high number of goals Roma has scored is a positive signal, and Udinese's Runjaic claimed Roma exploited every mistake made by his side. CBS Sports highlights Francesco Totti's 2002 volley against Udinese as a historic Roma masterpiece.

headline: Roma faces scrutiny as Inzaghi reflects on Napoli draw and Totti's historic legacy.
